publicationPolicy.catalogScope: Every repository skill appears in this repository-only selection. Only public-ready entries appear in public artifacts.
publicationPolicy.sourceRule: A public-ready entry carries its exact instruction source and every supporting file selected for publication.
publicationPolicy.possibleRule: A public-possible entry stays wholly outside public HTML, JSON, source copies, manifests, and links until its complete source package is ready for the same audience.
publicationPolicy.readinessRule: Public-ready describes a publication-safe, coherent source package with a receiving use. Evidence standing remains explicit in the generated exchange projection.
publicationPolicy.authorityRule: Each SKILL.md remains semantic authority. The generated JSON is an exchange projection, and current intent plus granted authority governs each use.
